forms.note: No serial numbers on these cylinders, so they are tracked as a quantity batch. The system never invents cylinder IDs.
Ownership changes always need approval and stay in the audit trail.
Total debit must equal total credit. A posted journal is corrected only by a reversal or adjustment entry.
Deposit money is a liability. It never counts as sales revenue or profit.
A shortage is not treated as employee misconduct. It stays open until it is investigated and a manager decides.
This inspection is a visual check. It does not replace the certified cylinder testing the law requires.
Quarantined cylinders cannot be loaded or sold until released by an authorized person.
Credit is off for every customer until management turns it on here.
During transit the stock is counted in neither warehouse, only as "in transit".
Only server-confirmed sales count. Shortage decisions are applied only after a manager decides.
Gas-leak complaints are marked high priority and the customer is told to turn off the cylinder valve and ventilate the room.
Forecasts are estimates from past sales, not promised sales. A manager can override every number.
A restore to the live system needs Super Admin approval, a verified backup and a written plan.
Which licenses apply must be checked against current Bangladesh rules. Recording a license here does not by itself mean the business is compliant.
